title: A White House official says Zuckerberg opposed a US AI regulator in a call with Trump last month; another source says he didn't ask Trump to change his stance (Politico)
summary: Politico: A White House official says Zuckerberg opposed a US AI regulator in a call with Trump last month; another source says he didn't ask Trump to change his stance — Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg expressed concerns about plans for a national AI regulator in a previously unreported phone call …
